with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_uat"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_uat"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_uat"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_uat"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY extract_time DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM JoinedData
WHERE scd_transaction_number_primary_key IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY row_count DESC ) ds LIMIT 0

/* QuickSight cd21354a-a8d5-4d9d-b877-2a51de1620d5 */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select

				from

				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates

					, extract_time

					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage

					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month

				, external_reporting_currency

				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from

			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region

		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )

with
	trans as (
		select
			trans.*,
			ss.cppib_sec_id, 
            ss.reporting_id_name,
			row_number() over (
		                partition by 
		                	trans.model_portfolio_id, 
		                	trans.abor_security_number, 
		                	trans.abor_transaction_number,
		                	trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key, -- same transaction number can have different primary key
		                	trans.elementary_transaction_code
						order by
							trans.changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
		           ) as rn
		from trades_deals.scd_transactions trans -- this is main transaction table
		left join reference.scd_securities ss on trans.abor_security_id = ss.abor_security_id and cast(trans.business_date as Date) = cast(ss.business_date as Date) 
		WHERE
			trans.accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
			AND trans.business_date >= '2025-03-01' -- give T-8 business date so that it can fetch all data.
			and trans.trade_date >= '2025-04-01' -- trade date
	),
	fin as (
        select
            fin.*,
            row_number() over (
                        partition by
                            fin.gl_account_id,
                            fin.gl_transaction_number,
                            fin.finance_transaction_index,
                            fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key,  -- same transaction number can have different primary key
                            fin.booking_type
                        order by
                            fin.extract_time desc
                   ) as rn
        from
            finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        where
            fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
            and fin.booking_type = 'Agreement date booking'
            and fin.gl_account_id not in ('1050-0000-010')
	),
	mp as (
	-- get the latest MP list for the credit investments
        select
            business_date,
            id_model_portfolio,
            model_portfolio_name,
            row_number() over (
                    partition by id_model_portfolio
        order by
            business_date desc
                ) as rn
        from
            finance_accounting.v_investment_structure
        where
            level_0_nodename = 'CPPIB_F24'
            and level_2_nodename = 'Credit Investments'
            and cast(business_date as DATE) >= DATE('2025-03-01')
	)
	
	
	select
		trans.payment_date as "Payment Date",
		trans.settlement_date as "Settlement Date",
		trans.model_portfolio_id as "Model Portfolio Code",
		trans.abor_security_id as "Security ID - Current",
		trans.abor_security_name as "Security Name - Current",
		trans.cppib_sec_id as "CPPIBSecID",
        trans.reporting_id_name as "Reporting ID Name - Current",
        trans.abor_security_group_name as "Security Type Code - Current",
		fin.gl_account_name as "Finance Account Name",
		fin.gl_account_id as "Finance Account No.",
		trans.abor_transaction_number as "Transaction No.",
		fin.gl_transaction_number as "FIN Transaction No.",
		trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key as "trans key",
		fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key as "fin trans key",
		trans.business_transaction_code as "Business Transaction Code",
		trans.quotation_currency as "Quoted Currency Code - Transaction",
		fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Debit Amount PC",
		fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Credit Amount PC",
		fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Debit Amount QC",
		fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Credit Amount QC",
		trans.business_transaction_code_name as "Business Transaction Code Name",
		trans.trade_date as "Trade Date",
		trans.created_date as "Created Date",
		trans.nominal as "Sum Nominal",
		trans.price as "Price QC",
		trans.payment_amount_portfolio_currency as "Sum Net Proceeds PC",
		trans.payment_amount_quotation_currency as "Sum Net Proceeds QC",
		trans.transaction_cancellation_flag as "Transaction Cancellation Flag Name",
		fin.cost_name as "Cost Name",
		fin.gl_transaction_number as "fin transaction number",
		trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
		fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
	from
		mp
	left join trans
		on
		trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.id_model_portfolio
	left join fin
	    on
		trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
		and fin.rn = 1
	where
		trans.rn = 1
	    AND trans.abor_security_id NOT LIKE 'DUMMY%'
    	AND trans.elementary_transaction_code NOT IN ('BalBook','EOP adj.')
		and mp.rn = 1
		and trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
		and fin.gl_account_id is not null
	order by
		trans.payment_date asc,
		trans.settlement_date asc,
		trans.model_portfolio_id,
		trans.business_transaction_code,
		fin.gl_account_name

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-28')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-28')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-28')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

        CASE
          WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN pv * 0.1
          WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
              AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0  
          WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1

          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.075
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.05
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.03
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then pv * 0.025

      from
        radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
        total_pv,

      FROM
        WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI

    where limit > 0 AND round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 ) > 100
  order by ce_by_party desc

	client_ip

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-05'
)

SELECT a.*, b.*, c.*
FROM (
    SELECT
        h.portfolio_id AS id_portfolio,
        h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
        h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        CASE 
            WHEN h.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN h.cppib_sec_id
            ELSE h.abor_security_number
        END AS id_instrument,
        sec.abor_security_group_id AS instrument_subgroup_code,
        h.security_group_name AS instrument_subgroup_name,
        sec.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
        h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
        h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS current_nominal,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS market_value,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS book_value,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS quoted_currency_code,
        h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
    LEFT JOIN RankedSecurities sec
        ON h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id

      AND sec.rn = 1

/* cppi::42e814d3e7a2ea6e2be1373b11ad3379114771053a0080800f8d0eb97b5d2522 */
select 
var.benchmark_name,
var.hierarchy_type,
var.hierarchy_node,
CAST(var.var95 AS decimal(22,6)) as var95,
CAST(b.mean AS decimal(22,6)) as mean,
CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_var
where business_date = '2025-06-05' 
and benchmark_name = 'CSG_BM' and hierarchy_type = 'RISK' and hierarchy_node = 'Credit Investments'
and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id in
( select run_id from dag_runs where dag_id = 'active_risk_dag' and business_date = '2025-06-05')
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-05' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol 
where business_date = '2025-06-05' and analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and c.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and c.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_cs01
where business_date = '2025-06-05' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as d on var.run_id = d.run_id and d.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and d.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and d.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as dv01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(dv01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-06-05' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as e on var.run_id = e.run_id and e.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and e.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and e.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_level, pv, run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv 
where business_date = '2025-06-05'
) as f on var.run_id = f.run_id and f.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-05'
)
select  a.*, b.*, c.*
from 
(select 
    ss.portfolio_id as id_portfolio,
    ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
	ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
	null as id_enterprise_holding,
	ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument,
    ss.security_group_id as instrument_subgroup_code,
    ss.security_group_name as instrument_subgroup_name,
    ss.abor_security_type_id as instrument_type_code,
    ss.abor_security_type_name as instrument_type_name,
    ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
	ss.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
	ss.balance_nominal_number * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
	ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_market_value,
	ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_market_value_pc,
	ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as book_value,
	ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as cost_value,
	ss.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as current_accrued_amount,
	ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
	ss.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as cost_value_pc,
	ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as current_accrued_amount_pc,
	ss.coupon_rate as current_interest_rate,
	ss.abor_maturity_date as maturity_date,
	ss.clean_price as current_clean_price,
	ss.dirty_price as current_dirty_price,
	ss.exposure_quotation_currency as exposure,
	'2025-06-05' as business_date,
	ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
	ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
	ss.quotation_currency_code as quoted_currency_code,
	null as next_coupon_date
from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
left join RankedSecurities sec 
	on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
where ss.business_date = '2025-06-05'
and sec.rn = 1
and sec.abor_security_group_id = 'INTFUNDING'
) as a
 left join
    (select
     currency_code,
     currency_name
     from reference.reference_currency_codes
     where business_date = date'2025-06-05'
)as b
On a.quoted_currency_code = b.currency_code
 left join
    ( select 
     model_portfolio_key,
     id_model_portfolio, 
     unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
     from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
     where business_date = date'2025-06-05'
) as c
on a.id_model_portfolio = c.id_model_portfolio

    ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
	ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
	null as id_enterprise_holding,
	ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument,
    ss.security_group_id as instrument_subgroup_code,
    ss.security_group_name as instrument_subgroup_name,
    ss.abor_security_type_id as instrument_type_code,
    ss.abor_security_type_name as instrument_type_name,
    ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
	ss.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
	ss.balance_nominal_number * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
	ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_market_value,
	ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_market_value_pc,
	ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as book_value,
	ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as cost_value,
	ss.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as current_accrued_amount,
	ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
	ss.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as cost_value_pc,
	ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as current_accrued_amount_pc,
	ss.coupon_rate as current_interest_rate,
	ss.abor_maturity_date as maturity_date,
	ss.clean_price as current_clean_price,
	ss.dirty_price as current_dirty_price,
	ss.exposure_quotation_currency as exposure,
	'2025-06-05' as business_date,
	ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
	ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
	ss.quotation_currency_code as quoted_currency_code,
	null as next_coupon_date
from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
left join RankedSecurities sec 
	on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
where ss.business_date = '2025-06-05'
and sec.rn = 1
and sec.abor_security_group_id = 'INTFUNDING'
) as a
 left join
    (select
     currency_code,
     currency_name
     from reference.reference_currency_codes
     where business_date = date'2025-06-05'
)as b
On a.quoted_currency_code = b.currency_code
 left join
    ( select 
     model_portfolio_key,
     id_model_portfolio, 
     unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
     from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
     where business_date = date'2025-06-05'
) as c
on a.id_model_portfolio = c.id_model_portfolio
